title: SP3 Protein Extraction for Dental Calculus
author: Shevan Wilkin
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bfgrjjv6
materials: Carefully invert the bottles of bead stock solutions and knock (!) them firmly on the counter to gain an equal distribution of the beads in the stock solution. Stock concentration of the bead stock solutions: 50 mg/ml. Beads tend to be very sticky! Make sure you can visibly see that the beads are no longer stuck to the walls of the bottle before pipetting.
Weight out 395 mg of AmBic powder.

While waiting for your samples on the Thermoshaker, label a new set of microcentrifuge tubes. These tubes are to collect a further supernatant (see Step 32) to keep as backup. Use the suffix "SP3 sup" for labeling.

After 10 min of incubation, remove your tubes and give your samples approximately 00:05:00 to cool and turn the Thermoshaker to 24 °C . If necessary, you can speed up the cooling process of the Thermoshaker with prepared microcentrifuge tubes of ice.
Acidification Remove the samples from the Thermoshaker and centrifuge them briefly.

While waiting for your samples on the Thermoshaker, label a new set of microcentrifuge tubes. These tubes are to collect a further supernatant (see Step 32) to keep as backup. Use the suffix "SP3 sup" for labeling.

steps.title: Prepare Bead Solution
steps.instruction: Prepare a bead working solution with a concentration of 20 µg/µl.

substeps.instruction: Pipette 200 µL each of hydrophobic and hydrophilic beads into one microcentrifuge tube and combine.
Place the tube on a magnetic rack, remove and discard the stock supernatant.
Replace with 1000 µL molecular grade water and resuspend by pipetting up and down (first wash).
Repeat the wash 2x.
After the final wash, add 1000 µL molecular grade water and resuspend to mix.

steps.title: Prepare Reduction and Alkylation Solution
steps.instruction: Prepare a 1 mL solution of 100 mM CAA and 100 mM TCEP.

substeps.instruction: Weigh 28.66 mg of TCEP into a 1.5 or 2.0 mL tube.
Weigh 9.35 mg of CAA into a 1.5 mL black tube (light sensitive).
Add 1 mL molecular grade water to the TCEP tube and vortex until dissolved.
Transfer the TCEP solution to the CAA tube and vortex for 1 minute.

steps.title: Prepare 6 M Guanidine Hydrochloride (GuHCl)
steps.instruction: Prepare 50 mL of 6 M GuHCl solution. Note: Never mix or clean GuHCl with bleach to avoid toxic chlorine gas.

substeps.instruction: Weigh 28.66 g GuHCl powder into a 50 mL tube.
Aliquot approximately 40 mL of water into a 50 mL tube.
Mix the GuHCl with 25 mL molecular grade water and check volume.
Fill up to 50 mL with molecular grade water and transfer to a 50 mL glass bottle.

steps.title: Prepare Ethanol Solutions
steps.instruction: Prepare 100% and 80% (v/v) Ethanol solutions.

substeps.instruction: For 100% (v/v): Aliquot 50 mL HPLC grade Ethanol into a 50 mL bottle.
For 80% (v/v): Add 40 mL HPLC grade Ethanol and 10 mL molecular grade water into a 50 mL bottle.

steps.title: Prepare 100 mM Ammonium Bicarbonate (AmBic)
steps.instruction: Prepare 100 mM AmBic (pH 8).

substeps.instruction: Dissolve AmBic powder in 50 mL molecular grade water and mix by shaking gently.

steps.title: Prepare 5% (v/v) Trifluoroacetic Acid (TFA)
steps.instruction: Prepare 5% TFA in a brown glass bottle using a glass syringe/pipette (avoid plastic).

substeps.instruction: Dilute 1 mL TFA stock solution in 19 mL molecular grade water (add water first, then acid slowly) and mix by shaking carefully.

steps.title: Prepare 3% ACN, 0.1% TFA Solution
steps.instruction: Prepare 100 mL of 3% (v/v) Acetonitrile (ACN) and 0.1% (v/v) TFA.

substeps.instruction: Pour roughly 80 mL molecular grade water into a 100 mL glass bottle.
Add 3 mL ACN by pipetting and fill up to 100 mL with molecular grade water.
Add 100 µL TFA using a glass syringe/pipette.

steps.title: Prepare 60% ACN, 0.1% TFA Solution
steps.instruction: Prepare 50 mL of 60% (v/v) ACN and 0.1% (v/v) TFA.

substeps.instruction: Pour 20 mL molecular grade water into a 50 mL glass bottle.
Add 30 mL ACN.
Add 50 µL TFA using a glass syringe/pipette.

steps.title: Prepare 100% (v/v) MeOH
steps.instruction: Aliquot 50 mL analysis grade MeOH into a 50 mL bottle.

steps.title: Prepare Trypsin Solution
steps.instruction: Resuspend freeze-dried Trypsin to a final concentration of 0.2 µg/µl.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend 20 µg freeze-dried Trypsin in 100 µL trypsin resuspension buffer.
Transfer to a labeled 0.5 mL tube and store at -20 °C.

steps.title: Sample Weighing and Preparation
steps.instruction: Weigh samples and positive control in a dedicated sample preparation hood.

substeps.instruction: Weigh 5 mg - 10 mg of dental calculus (removed via dental scaler) into a microcentrifuge tube and record exact weight.
Weigh 2 mg - 3 mg of powdered archaeological sheep bone as a positive control.

steps.title: Demineralization
steps.instruction: Demineralize samples using EDTA.

substeps.instruction: Add 500 µL of 0.5 M EDTA to each sample and a blank tube (EDTA only).
Place on a rotator for 4-7 days at Room Temperature (or 4 °C/incubator if RT > 30 °C) until visibly demineralized (no mineralized chunks remaining).
If not proceeding immediately, store samples at -20 °C and thaw completely before use.

steps.title: Sample Recovery and Preparation
steps.instruction: Separate supernatant and prepare for lysis.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge samples at 20,000 x g (or max speed) for 10 minutes at Room Temperature.
Remove 400 µL of supernatant and transfer to tubes labeled 'EDTA Sup' for backup storage at -20 °C (leaving 100 µL and pellet in original tube).
Set Thermoshaker to 99 °C.

steps.title: Denaturing and Lysis
steps.instruction: Lyse the protein pellet using GuHCl.

substeps.instruction: Add 200 µL of 6 M GuHCl to each sample and resuspend to mix.
Briefly centrifuge to collect liquid at the bottom.

steps.title: Reduction and Alkylation
steps.instruction: Reduce and alkylate proteins.

substeps.instruction: Add 30 µL of the prepared 100 mM CAA/100 mM TCEP solution to each tube (final concentration 10 mM each).
Vortex each sample for ~2 seconds.
Incubate in Thermoshaker at 0 rpm, 99 °C for 10 minutes.
Briefly centrifuge to collect liquid at the bottom.

steps.title: Protein Purification (SP3 Binding)
steps.instruction: Bind proteins to SP3 beads.

substeps.instruction: Add 20 µL of working bead solution (20 µg/µl) to each tube and mix by gentle pipetting to ensure homogenization (final bead concentration 1.14 µg/µL).
Add 350 µL of 100% (v/v) Ethanol (volume should equal the current solution volume) and shake briefly by hand.
Incubate on Thermoshaker at 1000 rpm, 24 °C for 5 minutes.
Place on magnetic rack for ~2 minutes until beads migrate to the wall.
Remove the sample/Ethanol solution and store in tubes labeled 'SP3 Sup' at -20 °C.

steps.title: Bead Washing
steps.instruction: Wash the bound proteins to remove contaminants.

substeps.instruction: Add 200 µL of 80% (v/v) Ethanol and resuspend beads gently.
Place on magnetic rack, migrate beads, and discard supernatant.
Repeat the 80% Ethanol wash two more times (total of 3 washes).
Remove as much Ethanol supernatant as possible (≤ 5 µL remaining).

steps.title: Tryptic Digestion
steps.instruction: Digest proteins into peptides.

substeps.instruction: Incubate samples in Thermoshaker for 10 min at 750 rpm, 37 °C (OR sonicate for 30 seconds at Room Temperature) to disaggregate beads.
Add 1 µL of 0.2 µg/µl trypsin solution (0.2 µg total) to each tube.
Incubate on Thermoshaker at 750 rpm, 37 °C for 18 hours.

steps.title: Peptide Recovery and Acidification
steps.instruction: Recover peptides and acidify to stop digestion.

substeps.instruction: Mix samples by pipetting up and down to distribute beads and trypsin.
Remove tubes from magnetic rack and add 75 µL of 100 mM AmBic solution; push beads down with a tip but do not resuspend or shake.
Place on magnetic rack until beads migrate to the wall.
Transfer the entire sample supernatant to new labeled tubes and discard the beads.
Add 10 µL of 5% (v/v) TFA to bring pH below 2.5.
Vortex quickly and test pH with strips; add additional 5 µL of 5% TFA if necessary to reach pH < 2.5.

steps.title: Peptide Purification (StageTipping)
steps.instruction: Purify peptides using C18 StageTips.

substeps.instruction: Clean StageTips: Add 150 µL MeOH, centrifuge at 2000 x g for 1 minute.
Equilibrate StageTips: Add 150 µL 3% ACN, 0.1% TFA, centrifuge at 2000 x g for 1 minute. Repeat this step once more.
Transfer StageTips to tubes labeled 'Load/Wash' to collect flow-through.
Centrifuge acidified samples briefly to remove particles.
Place acidified sample tubes on magnetic rack to ensure no beads are transferred.
Transfer sample to StageTip and centrifuge at 2000 x g for 3 minutes.
Wash StageTip: Add 150 µL 3% ACN, 0.1% TFA, centrifuge at 2000 x g for 2 minutes. Repeat this wash once more.
Store 'Load/Wash' tubes at -20 °C.

steps.title: Peptide Elution
steps.instruction: Elute peptides for mass spectrometric analysis.

substeps.instruction: Store StageTips at -20 °C until elution.
To elute: Transfer StageTip to a new tube, add 60% (v/v) ACN, 0.1% (v/v) TFA, and centrifuge at 2000 x g for 2 minutes.
